verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens that can be scoped to restrict the operations they perform, for example a read-only integration token. That is a first-party, least-privilege credential an agent can be issued. missing for 10: details on scope granularity (per-resource or per-environment limits, custom roles on tokens, expiry/rotation), any agent-specific credential guidance (e.g., how scoped tokens tie into the MCP server), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
